description:
You have never procrastinated more than I used to—

I ain’t no productivity guru pretending to get it, I started procrastinating 25 years ago

And I did it for over 20 years—the minute I got the chance I was off to the races—so how’d I get here??

(and let me quickly say, this is a story of HOPE)

I procrastinated maths for 12 years, completing homework maaaaaybe 1 in 5 times:

(giving pitiful and overwhelmingly stressful excuses the rest of the time) 

What changed?

I had three weeks to study for one of the biggest exams in my schooling career:

I started 2 weeks and 6 days in, after completing a full rewatch of all 6 seasons of parks and rec.

What broke the pattern?

I stopped work in my Honours year halfway through first semester and didn’t start until semester break—

Past all of my deadlines. 

YES BUT HOW DID THINGS CHANGE??

The short version is two-fold:

1. I realised that if I liked CERTAIN action, I mustn’t hate action ITSELF (I.e. maybe there was hope?)—

How could I start to like more kinds of action? (and lo and behold, I learned how)

2. I discovered that design (what I studied at uni) held the secret to eliminating procrastination altogether—

—by killing the pain that causes it in the first place.

BUT there’s only one thing I want you to take away from this.

Ending procrastination IS possible. You CAN take easy action. And this account and business is proof.

Which is why I coach the hardest fuckin’ problem I can think of—chronic procrastination—

Because if you’re stuck in inaction, you’re me, and I know it fuckin sucks, and I don’t want to leave you there

So if you want to change this shit, comment ‘pigeon’ to get set up with a newsletter designed for you
